positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: I’m joining the Oculus Platform SDK team to help improve the first- and third- party developer experience and quality.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and expanded an LLM-based shopping experience to support natural conversational experiences - expanding the initial prototype beyond search and refinements to include diving into product details, answering product Q&A, and adding products to the cart - with support for ambiguous, ordinal, nominal references to items based on state/context and history of the interaction.

Expanded Self-Service Campaigns for Alexa from Device Notifications to include Home Cards as a new channel, reaching millions of customers with proactive Book recommendations on evergreen campaigns.

Lead technical Point of Contact for Books customer experiences within Alexa Shopping.

Expanded support for Audible audiobooks within Alexa Shopping to Brazil marketplace.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Programming · Debugging · Analytic Problem Solving · guava · AWS Lambda · Amazon EC2 · Communication · Databases · docker · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Guice · Microservices · Alexa · Large Language Models (LLM)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Delivered significant performance improvements for Policy Studio, an API Gateway management IDE.

Developed across iOS, Android, and Windows SDK platforms for Appcelerator Titanium - both in JavaScript and each platform's native language (Obj-C, Java and C++, respectively).
Created an automated test suite to verify APIs across all platforms, including on emulators, simulators and physical devices.
Instituted and maintained a ~25 node Jenkins based build infrastructure, maintaining child nodes with custom chef cookbooks; including evolving build targets to latest Xcode, iOS, macOS, Android platforms over time.
Drove usage and enforcement of code quality, formatting, linting and developmental tools using clang-format, danger.js, eslint, husky, lint-staged, committizen, etc.
Overhauled API documentation process to automate and deliver new Vue.js based website.
Created custom linting tools to validate documentation format and generate automated tests via the documentation of our APIs.
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · Programming · Debugging · Analytic Problem Solving · Communication · TypeScript · jacoco · JUnit

positions.title: Engineering Tech Lead
positions.description:
Tech lead for the Studio IDEs: Appcelerator, Titanium and Aptana.

Initial implementation of Hyperloop for Android - exposing native (Java) Android & 3rd party APIs to Titanium SDK's JS environment.

One of the engineers responsible for adding Windows Phone and Desktop SDK support to Appcelerator Titanium's supported platforms.

Worked cross-product on Studio, Android SDK, iOS SDK, and Windows SDKs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior developer on Appcelerator, Titanium, and Aptana Studio products - IDEs built on top of Eclipse with varying branding and toolsets offered (for languages such as JS, Ruby, PHP, Python).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Solo developer on Aptana RadRails - a Rails-focused IDE built on top of Eclipse and Aptana Studio, which added Ruby language support and tooling.

positions.title: Senior Web Technologist R&D
positions.description: Assisted in M&A discussions, research on software solutions for IT. Developed prototype internal web applications using Ruby on Rails.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Programming · Debugging · Communication · Databases

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of a team that developed an integrated network client that monitored printer usage, meters, hardware readings and could remotely report data for proactive maintenance, re-ordering and repairs. Assisted in efforts to establish a common set of data points and models for comparing reported data from multiple (differing) clients across different printer product lines - to aid in cross-product reliability metrics and re-use common code and queries for analyzing the data.
